test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ****1999.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana (JGSY) is the restructured, streamlined, and comprehen­sive version of the erstwhile Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY).**
 
• Launched on 1st April 1999, it has been designed to improve the quality of life of the rural poor by providing them additional gainful employment
 
• The main objective of the scheme is the **creation of demand-driven village infrastructure** including durable assets for increasing the opportunities for sustained employment and generation of supplementary employment for the unem­ployed poor in rural areas. 
 
• The program is being implemented entirely at the** village panchayat level.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Village panchayat is the sole authority for the preparation of the annual action plan and its implementation with the approval of Gram Sabha. 

 
 
• **22.5 per cent of JGSY **funds have been earmarked for indi­vidual beneficiary schemes for SCs/STs. 
 
• Three per cent of annual allocation would be utilized for the creation of barrier-free infrastructure for the disabled.
 
 
 
• The state government will fix wages under JGSY.
 
 
• Village panchayats will have the power to execute works/ schemes up to **Rs.50, 000 **with the approval of Gram Sabha.
 
• However, for works/schemes costing more than** Rs50, 000,** after taking the approval of the Gram Sabha, the Village panchayat shall seek the technical/administrative approval of appropriate authorities.
